name: multi-discipline-musician
texts: I'm a musician and a YouTuber and I have a podcast that I published on YouTube and I run a course Company for guitarist called Sonora
I make most of my money through teaching and booking gigs and doing session work
honestly keeping up with everything, booking and the course business
expect: Keeps all four disciplines (musicians, youtubers, podcasters, teachers), mentions Sonora, uses 'Spencer' not the full name, and never suggests galleries or other fields' terms.

name: answers-two-at-once
texts: Maya, I paint big oil landscapes and sell through two galleries
tracking which gallery has which painting is a nightmare
expect: Captures name, painter, and gallery income from one text, then skips the money question. Starts with the inventory or galleries step.

name: tattoo-artist-terse
expect: Filed as a tattoo artist with tattoo-specific examples. Hours 14:00-22:00 Los Angeles. First step deals with deposits or booking rules because the headache is no-shows.

name: asks-a-question-mid-onboarding
texts: wait, what is this exactly? who are you
expect: Answers what Studio is in a sentence before asking again. Doesn't lose the thread. Photographer, Chicago time, no quiet hours.

name: post-onboarding-task
texts: figuring out if a tour made money
Nov 7 Basement East Nashville $800 guarantee, Nov 9 Grey Eagle Asheville $500 vs 80% of door. drummer $150/show, gas $120/day
expect: Builds a shows page with correct math (drummer $300 for two shows, gas at $120 per day with the number of days stated as an assumption, $1,300 guaranteed) and links it, then moves to the next setup step with one question.

name: maker-unsure-which-channel-pays
texts: Etsy, a couple of weekend markets, and some wholesale to gift shops
no idea which of those is actually worth my time
expect: Filed as a maker on Denver time. The first setup step ties back to which channel is worth the time (margins or where they sell), and that step is asked as one question.
